properties.description:
Use the existing header search as the ergonomic entry for filtering, without a global attention/filter strip. A generic extensible Relational Engine query system and Relational UI discovery/autocomplete component should expose contextual keywords to humans and agents, creators via createdby:, durations via lastchange:, boolean composition, sorting, and queries across nodes/files/other supported contexts. Save queries and organize them in an expandable bush. Exact syntax remains a proposal. User feedback on mockup Image 1 comment 11. Current work is a visual concept, not an implementation.

Clarification 29 September 2026: this is a foundational typed query composer across Relational Engine and Relational UI. Available nodes, fields, operators and value functions must reflect the queried data and its types. Examples include startsWith/endsWith, regex and among; exact names and grammar are illustrative. Engine owns typed definitions, validation, composition and execution; UI derives contextual completion from shared discovery metadata, also available to agents. Popup width equals search width; content left aligned, no heading/footer rows, consistent separators. Saved queries use a flat list for MVP. Global toolbar and view toolbar remain distinct.
properties.title: Composable contextual search with discoverable query keywords
